contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [A VIT]ELLIVS GERM IMP AVG TRP ; R/ LIBERTAS RESTITVTA

Silver coin. Denarius of Vitelius (69), mint of Rome, RIC (first edition) volume 1 no. 18, RIC volume 1 (second edition): 69. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [A VIT]ELLIVS GERM IMP AVG TRP. Reverse description: Libertas standing left holding pileus in right hand and spear or sceptre in left. Reverse inscription: LIBERTAS RESTITVTA. Diameter: 17.7mm, Weight: 2.91gms, die axis: 6
